data.reason_zh: 摘要明确以执行轨迹诊断并修改可复用 harness 组件，新证据驱动后续轮次，属方法型 RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components
scope_support.object_quote: We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply.
scope_support.persistence_quote: New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision.
